title: Agent-editable content-schema index
description: content-schemas.json at the root of a site's source folder: which JSON Schema applies to which configuration and content files. See spec/agent-editable/0.1.md, section 2.

schemas.description: One entry per group of files. A file that matches several entries must satisfy all of them.

version.description: The version of the agent-editable spec this index follows.

files.description: Globs over source paths: * matches within one segment, ** matches any number of segments.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12): a path relative to content-schemas.json that stays inside the source folder, or an https URL.

target.description: front-matter: the schema applies to the file's front matter. file: it applies to the whole parsed file.

when.description: Front-matter keys and the exact values a file must have for the entry to apply. Only with target front-matter.
